source: Observed live on 2026-10-22 (session 13): FL's in-window menu bar (FILE … HELP), cross-checked with the native macOS menu bar FL mirrors (Accessibility dump in docs/research/evidence/menus/). Screenshots: docs/research/evidence/screenshots/fl-menu-*.png.
notes: One record per menu item, in FL's order. path = FL's labels from the menu bar down (FL writes '...' for dialogs). section = the grey header the item sits under in-window. kind: action | dialog (opens a dialog or window) | submenu | toggle (checkmark) | radio | list (filled from data; static contents in `lists`) | link (opens a web page). fl_keys in macOS notation as FL shows them. fl_state = the state seen on a fresh default project (checked, selected, disabled). limeshot = where LimeShot has it (Menu › Item). status: IMPLEMENTED (same item), DIFFERENT (LimeShot has the action under another label or place, or without the key), LIMESHOT_ONLY (LimeShot menu item with no FL counterpart in that menu), NOT_STARTED, NOT_PLANNED (Image-Line services, FL's own plugins). Records added after the session 13 capture keep the order of FL's menus; LimeShot-only items follow the FL items of their menu.
